findings.summary: refreshBufferSeconds set to 6000 instead of 600, refreshing 100 minutes before expiry instead of the intended 10 minutes.
findings.mechanism: The task asked for a 10-minute (600s) refresh window before expiry, matching the original `86400 - 600` = 83400s threshold. The literal was replaced with `6000` (600 with an extra trailing zero), which is a buffer of 6000 seconds (100 minutes), not 600 seconds (10 minutes) as the adjacent comment still states. This causes Garmin tokens to refresh far earlier than intended, and since Garmin rotates the refresh token on every refresh, this increases the frequency of refresh-token rotation and the associated cross-isolate race window described in the new comment below.
